confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors rest on aggregator cost-of-living pages and dated guides (2019 to 2026) rather than a current price survey. Beer and cocktail figures come from a TripBase aggregate, coffee and inexpensive meal from nomadranker, and the mid-range meal from an expatexchange peso range. No usable source gave a wine price, so wine_glass is a rough estimate of about 2.5 times the beer anchor. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of General Luna and Siargao; no booking pages or current listings were checked. The FX observation is not confirmed on the official RBA page: the official RBA page surfaced in search showed 0.7088 for 20 March 2026, and the 0.6979 value for 2026-10-09 comes from a third-party AllRatesToday copy of RBA data that I could not verify on rba.gov.au. Treat the FX value as unverified and recheck it against the RBA F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Siargao is a tourist island in the Philippines, so food and drink prices were anchored to Philippine island tourism pricing, with General Luna as the main reference area. Accommodation was estimated holistically from general knowledge of Philippine island guesthouse and hostel pricing, not from listings.
